title.narrative: Life-saving emergency water, sanitation and hygiene infrastructure project supporting drought and conflict-affected communities in Puntland

description.narrative: 130,000 beneficiaries will directly benefit from well water - 20 deep wells with a tank, a solar energy system and all its accessories will be added to the water sources of the local community. - 6 wells will be rehabilitated, operated, and connected to solar energy systems to ensure their sustainability.

Providing potable water for those in need in Puntland. The project consists of two parts: The first: digging and constructing 20 artesian wells with electric pumps, installing a solar energy system for each well, and constructing a high tank for each well, in addition to all accessories according to the specifications approved by the center. Second: Rehabilitating 6 water stations by providing them with solar energy systems and installing and operating electric pumps for them.

This project aims to improve public health, drought conditions and conflict-affected populations in Somalia/Puntland. The project specifically targets drought and conflict-affected populations in five regions including Mudug, Nogal, Bari, Sol and Sanag by drilling and rehabilitating twenty-six [26] wells (twenty new wells and six rehabilitated wells).
